local categories = {
    "ONES",
    "TWOS",
    "THREES",
    "FOURS",
    "FIVES",
    "SIXES",
    "THREEKIND",
    "FOURKIND",
    "FULLHOUSE",
    "SMALL",
    "LARGE",
    "YAHTZEE",
    "CHANCE"
}
local category_index = {}
for i, category in ipairs(categories) do
    category_index[category] = i
end
local strategies = {KIND = true, STRAIGHT = true, HIGH = true, UPPER = true}
local jokers = {FORCED = true, FREE = true, OFF = true}
local powers = {1, 6, 36, 216, 1296, 7776}
local lower_mask = 0x1fc0

local function fail(format, ...)
    error({message = string.format(format, ...)}, 0)
end

local function positive(word, maximum)
    if not word:match("^[1-9][0-9]*$") then
        fail("bad value %s", word)
    end
    local value = tonumber(word, 10)
    if value > maximum then
        fail("bad value %s", word)
    end
    return value
end

local function check_name(word)
    if #word > 8 or not word:match("^[A-Z]+$") then
        fail("bad name %s", word)
    end
end

local function parse_pattern(word)
    if #word ~= 5 or word:find("[^01]") then
        fail("bad pattern %s", word)
    end
    return tonumber(word, 2)
end

local function parse_category(word)
    if not category_index[word] then
        fail("bad category %s", word)
    end
    return category_index[word]
end

local function parse_strategy(word)
    if not strategies[word] then
        fail("bad strategy %s", word)
    end
    return word
end

local function ascii_less(a, b)
    for i = 1, math.min(#a, #b) do
        local first, second = a:byte(i), b:byte(i)
        if first ~= second then
            return first < second
        end
    end
    return #a < #b
end

local function fraction(numerator, denominator)
    local a, b = numerator, denominator
    while b ~= 0 do
        a, b = b, a % b
    end
    numerator, denominator = numerator // a, denominator // a
    return denominator == 1 and tostring(numerator) or
        string.format("%d/%d", numerator, denominator)
end

local function average(sum, count)
    local value = count == 0 and 0 or 100 * sum // count
    return string.format("%d.%02d", value // 100, value % 100)
end

local function held(mask, die)
    return (mask & (1 << (5 - die))) ~= 0
end

local function pattern_text(mask)
    local text = {}
    for i = 1, 5 do
        text[i] = held(mask, i) and "1" or "0"
    end
    return table.concat(text)
end

local function faces_text(faces, mask)
    local selected = {}
    if faces then
        for i = 1, 5 do
            if held(mask or 31, i) then
                selected[#selected + 1] = tostring(faces[i])
            end
        end
    end
    return #selected == 0 and "-" or table.concat(selected, " ")
end

local function face_counts(faces)
    local counts = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}
    for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
        counts[face] = counts[face] + 1
    end
    return counts
end

local function decode(code)
    local counts = {}
    for i = 1, 6 do
        counts[i], code = code % 6, code // 6
    end
    return counts
end

local function held_code(faces, mask)
    local code = 0
    for i = 1, 5 do
        if held(mask, i) then
            code = code + powers[faces[i]]
        end
    end
    return code
end

local function frequent(counts)
    local face = 1
    for i = 2, 6 do
        if counts[i] >= counts[face] then
            face = i
        end
    end
    return face
end

local function yahtzee(counts)
    for _, count in ipairs(counts) do
        if count == 5 then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function normal_score(category, counts)
    if category <= 6 then
        return category * counts[category]
    end
    local total, largest, bits, pair, triple = 0, 0, 0, false, false
    for face, count in ipairs(counts) do
        total = total + face * count
        largest = math.max(largest, count)
        if count > 0 then
            bits = bits | (1 << (face - 1))
        end
        pair, triple = pair or count == 2, triple or count == 3
    end
    if category == 7 then
        return largest >= 3 and total or 0
    elseif category == 8 then
        return largest >= 4 and total or 0
    elseif category == 9 then
        return pair and triple and 25 or 0
    elseif category == 10 then
        return ((bits & 15) == 15 or (bits & 30) == 30 or (bits & 60) == 60) and 30 or 0
    elseif category == 11 then
        return (bits == 31 or bits == 62) and 40 or 0
    elseif category == 12 then
        return largest == 5 and 50 or 0
    else
        return total
    end
end

local Player = {}
Player.__index = Player
function Player.new(name)
    return setmetatable({name = name, strategy = "KIND", scores = {}, yahtzee_bonus = 0}, Player)
end
function Player:upper()
    local sum = 0
    for c = 1, 6 do
        sum = sum + (self.scores[c] or 0)
    end
    return sum
end
function Player:upper_bonus()
    return self:upper() >= 63 and 35 or 0
end
function Player:total()
    local sum = self:upper_bonus() + self.yahtzee_bonus
    for c = 1, 13 do
        sum = sum + (self.scores[c] or 0)
    end
    return sum
end
function Player:round()
    local round = 1
    for c = 1, 13 do
        if self.scores[c] ~= nil then
            round = round + 1
        end
    end
    return round
end

local function evaluate(player, counts, rule)
    local allowed = 0
    for c = 1, 13 do
        if player.scores[c] == nil then
            allowed = allowed | (1 << (c - 1))
        end
    end
    local joker = rule ~= "OFF" and yahtzee(counts) and player.scores[12] ~= nil
    if joker and rule == "FORCED" then
        local upper = frequent(counts)
        if (allowed & (1 << (upper - 1))) ~= 0 then
            allowed = 1 << (upper - 1)
        elseif (allowed & lower_mask) ~= 0 then
            allowed = allowed & lower_mask
        end
    end
    local points, best = {}, nil
    for c = 1, 13 do
        points[c] = -1
        if player.scores[c] == nil then
            if (allowed & (1 << (c - 1))) == 0 then
                points[c] = 0
            elseif joker and c >= 9 and c <= 11 then
                points[c] = ({25, 30, 40})[c - 8]
            else
                points[c] = normal_score(c, counts)
            end
            if not best or points[c] > points[best] then
                best = c
            end
        end
    end
    return {points = points, allowed = allowed, joker = joker, best = best}
end

local function make_outcomes()
    local result, factorial = {}, {1, 1, 2, 6, 24, 120}
    for size = 0, 5 do
        result[size] = {}
        local function add(face, remaining, code, divisor)
            if face == 7 then
                if remaining == 0 then
                    local list = result[size]
                    list[#list + 1] = {code = code, weight = factorial[size + 1] // divisor}
                end
                return
            end
            for count = 0, remaining do
                add(
                    face + 1,
                    remaining - count,
                    code + count * powers[face],
                    divisor * factorial[count + 1]
                )
            end
        end
        add(1, size, 0, 1)
    end
    return result
end
local outcomes = make_outcomes()

local function new_turn(seat)
    return {seat = seat or 1, rolls = 0, hold = 0}
end
local Game = {}
Game.__index = Game
function Game.new(seed, names, rolls, joker, output)
    local players = {}
    for i, name in ipairs(names) do
        players[i] = Player.new(name)
    end
    return setmetatable(
        {
            random_state = seed,
            players = players,
            max_rolls = rolls,
            joker = joker,
            output = output,
            loaded = {},
            loaded_head = 1,
            face_totals = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0},
            entries = {},
            redo_list = {},
            turn = new_turn()
        },
        Game
    )
end
function Game:emit(format, ...)
    if self.output then
        self.output(string.format(format, ...))
    end
end
function Game:current()
    return self.players[self.turn.seat]
end
function Game:check_turn()
    if not self.turn then
        fail("game over")
    end
end
function Game:check_rolled()
    self:check_turn()
    if self.turn.rolls == 0 then
        fail("not rolled")
    end
end
function Game:check_rolls_left()
    self:check_rolled()
    if self.turn.rolls == self.max_rolls then
        fail("no rolls left")
    end
end
function Game:roll()
    self:check_turn()
    local turn = self.turn
    if turn.rolls == self.max_rolls then
        fail("no rolls left")
    end
    if turn.hold == 31 then
        fail("all dice held")
    end
    self.redo_list = {}
    local faces = {}
    for i = 1, 5 do
        if turn.rolls > 0 and held(turn.hold, i) then
            faces[i] = turn.faces[i]
        else
            if self.loaded_head <= #self.loaded then
                faces[i] = self.loaded[self.loaded_head]
                self.loaded_head = self.loaded_head + 1
            else
                self.random_state = 48271 * self.random_state % 2147483647
                faces[i] = self.random_state % 6 + 1
            end
            self.face_totals[faces[i]] = self.face_totals[faces[i]] + 1
        end
    end
    self.turn = {seat = turn.seat, rolls = turn.rolls + 1, faces = faces, hold = turn.hold}
    self:emit("%s roll %d: %s", self:current().name, self.turn.rolls, faces_text(faces))
end
function Game:hold(mask)
    self:check_rolls_left()
    self.redo_list = {}
    local turn = self.turn
    self.turn = {seat = turn.seat, rolls = turn.rolls, faces = turn.faces, hold = mask}
    self:emit(
        "%s holds %s: %s",
        self:current().name,
        pattern_text(mask),
        faces_text(turn.faces, mask)
    )
end
function Game:keep(values)
    self:check_rolls_left()
    local mask = 0
    for _, value in ipairs(values) do
        local die
        for i = 1, 5 do
            if not held(mask, i) and self.turn.faces[i] == value then
                die = i
                break
            end
        end
        if not die then
            fail("not showing %d", value)
        end
        mask = mask | (1 << (5 - die))
    end
    self:hold(mask)
end
function Game:score(category, preview)
    self:check_rolled()
    local player = self:current()
    if player.scores[category] ~= nil then
        fail("%s already used", categories[category])
    end
    local counts = face_counts(self.turn.faces)
    local candidates = evaluate(player, counts, self.joker)
    if (candidates.allowed & (1 << (category - 1))) == 0 then
        local upper = frequent(counts)
        fail("joker requires %s", player.scores[upper] == nil and categories[upper] or "lower box")
    end
    local points = candidates.points[category]
    local bonus = yahtzee(counts) and player.scores[12] == 50 and 100 or 0
    local upper_bonus =
        category <= 6 and player:upper() < 63 and player:upper() + points >= 63 and 35 or 0
    local line =
        string.format(
        "%s %s %d in %s",
        player.name,
        preview and "would score" or "scores",
        points,
        categories[category]
    )
    if candidates.joker then
        line = line .. " joker"
    end
    if bonus ~= 0 then
        line = line .. " ybonus 100"
    end
    if upper_bonus ~= 0 then
        line = line .. " ubonus 35"
    end
    line = line .. string.format(" total %d", player:total() + points + bonus + upper_bonus)
    if preview then
        self:emit("%s", line)
        return
    end
    self.redo_list = {}
    local entry = {
        before = self.turn,
        category = category,
        points = points,
        bonus = bonus,
        joker = candidates.joker
    }
    self.entries[#self.entries + 1] = entry
    player.scores[category] = points
    player.yahtzee_bonus = player.yahtzee_bonus + bonus
    if #self.entries == 13 * #self.players then
        self.turn = nil
    else
        self.turn = new_turn(entry.before.seat % #self.players + 1)
    end
    self:emit("%s", line)
    if self.turn then
        self:emit("turn %d %s", self:current():round(), self:current().name)
    else
        self:emit("game over")
    end
end
function Game:undo()
    if #self.entries == 0 then
        fail("nothing to undo")
    end
    local entry = table.remove(self.entries)
    self.redo_list[#self.redo_list + 1] = {after = self.turn, entry = entry}
    local player = self.players[entry.before.seat]
    player.scores[entry.category] = nil
    player.yahtzee_bonus = player.yahtzee_bonus - entry.bonus
    self.turn = entry.before
    self:emit("undo %s %s %d", player.name, categories[entry.category], entry.points)
end
function Game:redo()
    if #self.redo_list == 0 then
        fail("nothing to redo")
    end
    local saved = table.remove(self.redo_list)
    local entry = saved.entry
    local player = self.players[entry.before.seat]
    player.scores[entry.category] = entry.points
    player.yahtzee_bonus = player.yahtzee_bonus + entry.bonus
    self.entries[#self.entries + 1] = entry
    self.turn = saved.after
    self:emit("redo %s %s %d", player.name, categories[entry.category], entry.points)
end
function Game:bot_hold(strategy)
    local faces, counts = self.turn.faces, face_counts(self.turn.faces)
    local target, mask = frequent(counts), 0
    if strategy == "STRAIGHT" then
        local best_start, best_length = 1, 0
        for start = 1, 6 do
            local last = start
            while last <= 6 and counts[last] > 0 do
                last = last + 1
            end
            if last - start >= best_length then
                best_start, best_length = start, last - start
            end
        end
        if best_length >= 3 then
            for face = best_start, best_start + best_length - 1 do
                for i = 1, 5 do
                    if faces[i] == face then
                        mask = mask | (1 << (5 - i))
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            return mask
        end
    end
    for i = 1, 5 do
        local keep =
            strategy == "HIGH" and faces[i] >= 5 or strategy ~= "HIGH" and faces[i] == target
        if keep then
            mask = mask | (1 << (5 - i))
        end
    end
    return mask
end
function Game:bot_turn()
    local strategy = self:current().strategy
    if self.turn.rolls == 0 then
        self:roll()
    end
    while self.turn.rolls < self.max_rolls do
        local mask = self:bot_hold(strategy)
        if mask == 31 then
            break
        end
        self:hold(mask)
        self:roll()
    end
    local counts = face_counts(self.turn.faces)
    local candidates = evaluate(self:current(), counts, self.joker)
    local target = frequent(counts)
    local category =
        strategy == "UPPER" and counts[target] >= 3 and
        (candidates.allowed & (1 << (target - 1))) ~= 0 and
        target or
        candidates.best
    self:score(category, false)
end
function Game:ranking()
    local seats = {}
    for i = 1, #self.players do
        seats[i] = i
    end
    table.sort(
        seats,
        function(a, b)
            local first, second = self.players[a]:total(), self.players[b]:total()
            if first ~= second then
                return first > second
            end
            return a < b
        end
    )
    return seats
end

local Adviser = {}
Adviser.__index = Adviser
function Adviser.new(player, joker)
    return setmetatable({player = player, joker = joker, values = {}, expectations = {}}, Adviser)
end
function Adviser:value(code, depth)
    local key = depth * 46656 + code
    if self.values[key] ~= nil then
        return self.values[key]
    end
    local counts, best = decode(code), -1
    if depth == 0 then
        local candidates = evaluate(self.player, counts, self.joker)
        best = candidates.points[candidates.best]
    else
        best = self:choose(counts, depth, 1, 0)
    end
    self.values[key] = best
    return best
end
function Adviser:choose(counts, depth, face, kept)
    if face == 7 then
        return self:expected(kept, depth)
    end
    local best = -1
    for count = 0, counts[face] do
        best = math.max(best, self:choose(counts, depth, face + 1, kept + count * powers[face]))
    end
    return best
end
function Adviser:expected(kept, depth)
    local key = depth * 46656 + kept
    if self.expectations[key] ~= nil then
        return self.expectations[key]
    end
    local rerolled, sum = 5, 0
    for _, count in ipairs(decode(kept)) do
        rerolled = rerolled - count
    end
    for _, outcome in ipairs(outcomes[rerolled]) do
        sum = sum + outcome.weight * self:value(kept + outcome.code, depth - 1)
    end
    local result = sum * powers[6 - rerolled]
    self.expectations[key] = result
    return result
end

local Program = {}
Program.__index = Program
function Program.new()
    return setmetatable({rolls = 3, joker = "FORCED", records = {}, output = {}}, Program)
end
function Program:emit(format, ...)
    self.output[#self.output + 1] = string.format(format, ...)
end
function Program:table()
    if not self.game then
        fail("no game")
    end
    return self.game
end
function Program:odds(game, mask)
    game:check_rolls_left()
    local kept = held_code(game.turn.faces, mask)
    local rerolled = 5
    for _, count in ipairs(decode(kept)) do
        rerolled = rerolled - count
    end
    local count, sums, chances, best = powers[rerolled + 1], {}, {}, 0
    for c = 1, 13 do
        sums[c], chances[c] = 0, 0
    end
    for _, outcome in ipairs(outcomes[rerolled]) do
        local candidates = evaluate(game:current(), decode(kept + outcome.code), game.joker)
        for c = 1, 13 do
            if candidates.points[c] >= 0 then
                sums[c] = sums[c] + outcome.weight * candidates.points[c]
                if candidates.points[c] > 0 then
                    chances[c] = chances[c] + outcome.weight
                end
            end
        end
        best = best + outcome.weight * candidates.points[candidates.best]
    end
    self:emit("odds %s outcomes %d", pattern_text(mask), count)
    for c = 1, 13 do
        if game:current().scores[c] == nil then
            self:emit(
                "%s expect %s chance %s",
                categories[c],
                fraction(sums[c], count),
                fraction(chances[c], count)
            )
        end
    end
    self:emit("best expect %s", fraction(best, count))
end
function Program:advise(game)
    game:check_rolls_left()
    local depth = game.max_rolls - game.turn.rolls
    local chosen, best, denominator = 0, -1, 1
    for _ = 1, depth do
        denominator = denominator * 7776
    end
    local adviser = Adviser.new(game:current(), game.joker)
    for mask = 0, 31 do
        local value = adviser:expected(held_code(game.turn.faces, mask), depth)
        if value > best then
            best, chosen = value, mask
        end
    end
    self:emit(
        "advise %s: %s expect %s",
        pattern_text(chosen),
        faces_text(game.turn.faces, chosen),
        fraction(best, denominator)
    )
end
function Program:card(game)
    local function row(heading, cell)
        local line = string.format("%-9s", heading)
        for _, player in ipairs(game.players) do
            line = line .. string.format(" %" .. math.max(4, #player.name) .. "s", cell(player))
        end
        self:emit("%s", line)
    end
    row(
        "CATEGORY",
        function(player)
            return player.name
        end
    )
    for c = 1, 13 do
        row(
            categories[c],
            function(player)
                return player.scores[c] ~= nil and tostring(player.scores[c]) or "-"
            end
        )
    end
    row(
        "UPPER",
        function(player)
            return tostring(player:upper())
        end
    )
    row(
        "BONUS",
        function(player)
            return tostring(player:upper_bonus())
        end
    )
    row(
        "YBONUS",
        function(player)
            return tostring(player.yahtzee_bonus)
        end
    )
    row(
        "TOTAL",
        function(player)
            return tostring(player:total())
        end
    )
end
function Program:simulate(seed, count, bots)
    local names, totals = {}, {}
    for i = 1, #bots do
        names[i], totals[i] =
            string.char(64 + i),
            {wins = 0, sum = 0, best = 0, bonus = 0, yahtzee = 0}
    end
    local state = seed
    for _ = 1, count do
        local game = Game.new(state, names, self.rolls, self.joker)
        for i, strategy in ipairs(bots) do
            game.players[i].strategy = strategy
        end
        while game.turn do
            game:bot_turn()
        end
        state = game.random_state
        local winner = game:ranking()[1]
        totals[winner].wins = totals[winner].wins + 1
        for i, player in ipairs(game.players) do
            local total = totals[i]
            total.sum, total.best = total.sum + player:total(), math.max(total.best, player:total())
            if player:upper_bonus() == 35 then
                total.bonus = total.bonus + 1
            end
            if player.scores[12] == 50 then
                total.yahtzee = total.yahtzee + 1
            end
        end
    end
    self:emit("sim seed %d games %d players %d", seed, count, #bots)
    for i, strategy in ipairs(bots) do
        local total = totals[i]
        self:emit(
            "seat %d %s wins %d average %s best %d bonus %d yahtzee %d",
            i,
            strategy,
            total.wins,
            average(total.sum, count),
            total.best,
            total.bonus,
            total.yahtzee
        )
    end
end
function Program:execute(words)
    local command = words[1]
    if command == "RULE" then
        if words[2] ~= "ROLLS" and words[2] ~= "JOKER" then
            fail("unknown rule %s", words[2])
        end
        local rolls, joker = self.rolls, self.joker
        if words[2] == "ROLLS" then
            rolls = positive(words[3], 4)
        elseif not jokers[words[3]] then
            fail("bad value %s", words[3])
        else
            joker = words[3]
        end
        if self.game then
            fail("game in progress")
        end
        self.rolls, self.joker = rolls, joker
        self:emit("rule %s %s", words[2], words[3])
    elseif command == "GAME" then
        local seed = positive(words[2], 2147483646)
        local names = {}
        for i = 3, #words do
            check_name(words[i])
            names[#names + 1] = words[i]
        end
        if #names > 6 then
            fail("too many players")
        end
        if self.game then
            fail("game in progress")
        end
        local seen = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(names) do
            if seen[name] then
                fail("duplicate name %s", name)
            end
            seen[name] = true
        end
        self.game =
            Game.new(
            seed,
            names,
            self.rolls,
            self.joker,
            function(line)
                self.output[#self.output + 1] = line
            end
        )
        self:emit("game seed %d players %s", seed, table.concat(names, " "))
        self:emit("turn 1 %s", names[1])
    elseif command == "BOT" then
        check_name(words[2])
        local strategy = parse_strategy(words[3])
        local game, selected = self:table(), nil
        for _, player in ipairs(game.players) do
            if player.name == words[2] then
                selected = player
                break
            end
        end
        if not selected then
            fail("no player %s", words[2])
        end
        selected.strategy = strategy
        self:emit("bot %s %s", words[2], words[3])
    elseif command == "LOAD" or command == "KEEP" then
        local values = {}
        for i = 2, #words do
            values[#values + 1] = positive(words[i], 6)
        end
        local game = self:table()
        if command == "KEEP" then
            game:keep(values)
        else
            for _, value in ipairs(values) do
                game.loaded[#game.loaded + 1] = value
            end
            self:emit("loaded %d", #game.loaded - game.loaded_head + 1)
        end
    elseif command == "ROLL" then
        self:table():roll()
    elseif command == "HOLD" or command == "ODDS" then
        local mask = parse_pattern(words[2])
        local game = self:table()
        if command == "HOLD" then
            game:hold(mask)
        else
            self:odds(game, mask)
        end
    elseif command == "SCORE" or command == "WHATIF" then
        local category = parse_category(words[2])
        self:table():score(category, command == "WHATIF")
    elseif command == "UNDO" then
        self:table():undo()
    elseif command == "REDO" then
        self:table():redo()
    elseif command == "SUGGEST" then
        local game = self:table()
        game:check_rolled()
        local candidates = evaluate(game:current(), face_counts(game.turn.faces), game.joker)
        local line = "suggest"
        for c = 1, 13 do
            if candidates.points[c] >= 0 then
                line = line .. string.format(" %s %d", categories[c], candidates.points[c])
            end
        end
        self:emit(
            "%s best %s %d",
            line,
            categories[candidates.best],
            candidates.points[candidates.best]
        )
    elseif command == "ADVISE" then
        self:advise(self:table())
    elseif command == "AUTO" then
        local count = positive(words[2], 100)
        local game = self:table()
        game:check_turn()
        game.redo_list = {}
        for _ = 1, count do
            if not game.turn then
                break
            end
            game:bot_turn()
        end
    elseif command == "STATUS" then
        local game = self:table()
        local turn = game.turn
        if not turn then
            self:emit("status game over")
        else
            self:emit(
                "status round %d player %s rolls %d dice %s holds %s",
                game:current():round(),
                game:current().name,
                turn.rolls,
                faces_text(turn.faces),
                pattern_text(turn.hold)
            )
        end
    elseif command == "CARD" then
        self:card(self:table())
    elseif command == "BONUS" then
        for _, player in ipairs(self:table().players) do
            local upper, maximum = player:upper(), player:upper()
            for c = 1, 6 do
                if player.scores[c] == nil then
                    maximum = maximum + 5 * c
                end
            end
            local status = upper >= 63 and "made" or maximum < 63 and "lost" or "open"
            self:emit(
                "bonus %s upper %d need %d max %d %s",
                player.name,
                upper,
                math.max(63 - upper, 0),
                maximum,
                status
            )
        end
    elseif command == "STATS" then
        local game = self:table()
        for seat, player in ipairs(game.players) do
            local turns, rolls, zeros, yahtzees, sum = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
            for _, entry in ipairs(game.entries) do
                if entry.before.seat == seat then
                    turns, rolls, sum = turns + 1, rolls + entry.before.rolls, sum + entry.points
                    if entry.points == 0 then
                        zeros = zeros + 1
                    end
                    if yahtzee(face_counts(entry.before.faces)) then
                        yahtzees = yahtzees + 1
                    end
                end
            end
            self:emit(
                "stats %s turns %d rolls %d zeros %d yahtzees %d average %s",
                player.name,
                turns,
                rolls,
                zeros,
                yahtzees,
                average(sum, turns)
            )
        end
    elseif command == "LOG" then
        local game = self:table()
        for i, entry in ipairs(game.entries) do
            self:emit(
                "log %d %s %s %s %d%s%s",
                i,
                game.players[entry.before.seat].name,
                faces_text(entry.before.faces),
                categories[entry.category],
                entry.points,
                entry.joker and " joker" or "",
                entry.bonus ~= 0 and " ybonus 100" or ""
            )
        end
        if #game.entries == 0 then
            self:emit("no scores")
        end
    elseif command == "FACES" then
        local game = self:table()
        local total, squares = 0, 0
        for _, count in ipairs(game.face_totals) do
            total, squares = total + count, squares + count * count
        end
        self:emit(
            "faces %s total %d chi2 %s",
            table.concat(game.face_totals, " "),
            total,
            fraction(6 * squares - total * total, total == 0 and 1 or total)
        )
    elseif command == "STANDINGS" or command == "END" then
        local game = self:table()
        local ranking, ending = game:ranking(), command == "END"
        if ending then
            self:emit("end %s", game.turn and "abandoned" or "final")
        end
        for rank, seat in ipairs(ranking) do
            local player = game.players[seat]
            if not ending then
                self:emit(
                    "standing %d %s %d behind %d",
                    rank,
                    player.name,
                    player:total(),
                    game.players[ranking[1]]:total() - player:total()
                )
            else
                self:emit("rank %d %s %d", rank, player.name, player:total())
                if not game.turn then
                    local record =
                        self.records[player.name] or {games = 0, wins = 0, best = 0, sum = 0}
                    record.games, record.sum, record.best =
                        record.games + 1,
                        record.sum + player:total(),
                        math.max(record.best, player:total())
                    if rank == 1 then
                        record.wins = record.wins + 1
                    end
                    self.records[player.name] = record
                end
            end
        end
        if ending then
            self.game = nil
        end
    elseif command == "RECORDS" then
        local names = {}
        for name in pairs(self.records) do
            names[#names + 1] = name
        end
        table.sort(
            names,
            function(a, b)
                local first, second = self.records[a], self.records[b]
                if first.wins ~= second.wins then
                    return first.wins > second.wins
                end
                if first.best ~= second.best then
                    return first.best > second.best
                end
                return ascii_less(a, b)
            end
        )
        for _, name in ipairs(names) do
            local record = self.records[name]
            self:emit(
                "record %s games %d wins %d best %d average %s",
                name,
                record.games,
                record.wins,
                record.best,
                average(record.sum, record.games)
            )
        end
        if #names == 0 then
            self:emit("no records")
        end
    elseif command == "SIM" then
        local seed = positive(words[2], 2147483646)
        local count = positive(words[3], 50)
        local bots = {}
        for i = 4, #words do
            bots[#bots + 1] = parse_strategy(words[i])
        end
        if #bots > 6 then
            fail("too many players")
        end
        self:simulate(seed, count, bots)
    else
        fail("unknown command %s", command)
    end
end

local count = tonumber(io.read("l"), 10)
local program = Program.new()
for _ = 1, count do
    local words = {}
    for word in io.read("l"):gmatch("%S+") do
        words[#words + 1] = word
    end
    local ok, problem = pcall(program.execute, program, words)
    if not ok then
        if type(problem) ~= "table" or not problem.message then
            error(problem, 0)
        end
        program:emit("error: %s", problem.message)
    end
end
if #program.output > 0 then
    io.write(table.concat(program.output, "\n"), "\n")
end
